provenance.cpm_denominator: sum of deposited workbook counts; not total mapped reads
provenance.replication_unit: three matched collection-day pools per condition, each containing three brains
provenance.estimand: median of three matched-pool log2 normalized-count differences, pseudocount 0.5
provenance.inference: descriptive only; no P values, DESeq2 reproduction, drug response or patient inference
provenance.row_selection: trisomy 8990 rows are a strict subset of CIN 14150; selection rule unresolved
